about.en: ASM is the token of Assemble AI, formerly Assemble Protocol, which now runs NS3, an AI-driven crypto news app that reads crypto and macro media in real time, classifies and analyses each story and publishes it in many languages. ASM is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x2565ae0385659badcada1031db704442e1b69982, with a deployment on Base at 0x3b53604113B5677291BFc0bc255379E7a796559b. An unrelated BNB Chain token also uses the ASM symbol (Alpha Synbo Meme, 0x3fc6b3c17e53580bad24978e199a62ee7ef995fd) and is not this asset.
